info.title: Cattle & Dairy Farm Management Platform
info.description: Centralized farm platform for cattle profiling, RFID tracking, milk logging, breeding lifecycles, feed allocation, and veterinary records.

get.description: List cattle with optional filtering by status, breed, RFID tag, or keyword search.

schema.title: Response List Cattle Api V1 Cattle Get

post.description: Register a new cow with RFID ear tag and lineage details.

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive profile, history, and active withdrawal status for a cow.

put.description: Update cattle profile, breed, or lifecycle status.

get.description: Retrieve milking session logs with optional filters.

schema.title: Response List Milk Logs Api V1 Milk Logs Get

post.description: Record a milking session yield with automatic withdrawal enforcement and >30% yield drop mastitis detection.

get.description: Get aggregate milk production KPIs, session totals, and 7-day rolling trends.
Retrieve reproductive lifecycle and breeding records with optional filters.

schema.title: Response List Breeding Records Api V1 Breeding Records Get

post.description: Record a new breeding event with automated 283-day gestation calculation and cycle reset handling.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific breeding record.

put.description: Update breeding record stage, dates, or notes and adjust cow status.

post.description: Calculate dynamic Total Mixed Ration (TMR) feed allocation based on lactation stage, milk yield, and body condition score (BCS).

get.description: Fetch cow profile, recent yield, and calculate personalized TMR feed allocation.
Retrieve TMR nutritional formulations per production group.

schema.title: Response List Feed Rations Api V1 Feed Rations Get

post.description: Create a new TMR feed ration profile.

get.description: Retrieve details for a specific TMR feed ration.

put.description: Update a TMR feed ration formulation.

get.description: Retrieve real-time feed inventory levels and stock reorder alerts.

schema.title: Response List Feed Inventory Api V1 Feed Inventory Get

post.description: Create or register a feed stock inventory item.

get.description: Get stock details for a specific feed item.

put.description: Update feed stock balance or consumption rate with automated threshold calculation.

get.description: Retrieve veterinary encounters, treatments, and vaccination history.

schema.title: Response List Health Records Api V1 Health Records Get

post.description: Log a veterinary encounter or treatment with automated milk/meat withdrawal calculations.

get.description: Retrieve scheduled routine vet checkups and upcoming vaccinations.

schema.title: Response List Scheduled Vet Visits Api V1 Health Records Schedules Get

post.description: Schedule a routine veterinary visit, herd health check, or vaccination event.

get.description: List all cattle currently subject to mandatory milk withdrawal due to active medical treatments.

schema.title: Response List Active Withdrawals Api V1 Health Records Active Withdrawals Get

post.description: Validate that none of the provided cattle are under active milk withdrawal before inclusion in bulk tank sales.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific health or treatment record.
Aggregate executive farm KPIs, 7-day rolling yield curves, fertility rates, and active alerts.
